title: Search jobs
intro: Your agent walks your job boards with your browser and adds what fits your profile. It only reads: it never applies for you.
unusable_one: {{count}} more job board is off or blocked. Change it in <to>Where to search</to>.
unusable_other: {{count}} more job boards are off or blocked. Change them in <to>Where to search</to>.
noneChosen: Choose at least one job board.

plan.title: Your search
plan.browser: Keep your browser connected to your agent.
plan.browserHint: In Claude Code, with the Claude in Chrome extension open in your Chrome and the same account. If it can't see it, your agent tells you and adds nothing.
plan.loginHint: It needs a session: your agent will tell you before going on.
plan.safe: It opens in a separate window where you see what it does. It can take several minutes.

noBrowser.title: Without a browser
noBrowser.body_one: {{count}} company or job board the app checks on its own: you can do it now, with no agent.
noBrowser.body_other: {{count}} companies and job boards the app checks on its own: you can do it now, with no agent.
noBrowser.none: Add <to>target companies</to> to check their jobs with no agent or browser.
noBrowser.others: Your <to>email alerts</to> and what you send with the <ext>browser button</ext> also come in on their own.

refine.hint: Just this once: your agent will use these instead of your saved searches. Your profile doesn't change.
refine.badText: Use only letters, numbers and simple signs (. , + # / & ( ) -).

empty.title: No job boards to search yet
empty.body: Tell your agent where you usually search or add a job board yourself.
empty.configure: Choose job boards with my agent

settings.title: What you're after
settings.intro: Roles, salary, place and contract decide what your agent looks for and which jobs pass your filters. Each block saves separately and recalculates the fit.
settings.issues: Your profile has errors to fix. See them in <to>My profile</to>.

noProfile.title: Your profile first
noProfile.body: What you're after is saved in your profile, and you don't have a readable one yet.
